scheme_name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (Nutritional Support To TB Patients)
other_conditions: Must be a Tuberculosis (TB) patient under treatment
Must be registered/notified on the NIKSHAY portal
Notification must be on or after 1 April 2018 (including existing patients under treatment)
benefits_summary: Financial incentive of ₹500 per month per notified TB patient, provided either as cash via DBT or as an in‑kind food basket of equivalent value.
